review_type: Independent visual review of saved Blender previews and UE runtime captures
observations: Boot cuffs overlap the shin armor in the reviewed rest and A/B/C poses; no open ankle seam was visible.
Round twin-tail attachments and their rear mounts remain seated against the hair roots.
The confirmed maid frill protrusions and separate ribbon pieces are hidden in the final preview.
No new suit penetration, open hole, accessory detachment, or weight tear was visible in the reviewed images.
UE B/C captures retain the same part placement and opaque coverage.
retained_source_limitations: Original scalp and hair geometry are preserved. The exposed source hair underside shading near the crown remains by design; no crown cover was added.

Six finger-joint stretch warnings reproduce the original source hand weights. Left ring-joint edge: glove 2.619x versus source 2.664x. Right pinky-joint edge: glove 3.201x versus source 2.884x; the 0.65 mm normal offset changes the short edge baseline.
scope_limit: This review covers the listed static captures. It does not claim that every gameplay animation or camera angle is free of intersection.
